desc:
🎃It's Halloween night and your little sister is gone. All she left behind is a candy wrapper with a drawing of the old mansion. You promised to find her. 🎃

🚪 Knock on doors and fill your basket with candy
💰 Sell candy and buy bigger baskets & upgrades
🥚 No treat? Prank stingy neighbors!
🤡 Don't stare at the clowns...
🐶 Run from the guard dog!
🍭 Collect all 61 candy packs in your Candy Journal
🏚️ Follow the trail to the old mansion
🕯️ Hide from the Hostess and rescue your sister
👥 Play solo or with friends

Can you bring her home?

🎮 CONTROLS
🖥️ PC: E / Click - Knock & interact, S - Leave, Tab - Menu
🎮 Console: X - Interact, B - Leave, Select - Menu
📱 Mobile: Tap doors & on-screen buttons

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates! 🎃

Tags: Trick or Treat, Halloween, Candy, Horror, Story, Mansion, Escape, Clowns, Spooky, Scary, Simulator, Adventure, Pranks, Haunted House
